newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran liberates "occupied island" in Gulf war games.
newsitem.headline: Iran liberates "occupied island" in Gulf war games.

text.p: Iranian forces staging a major military exercise landed from air and sea on a Gulf island on Thursday to defeat occupying "enemy troops", Tehran radio said.
It said navy forces, backed by intensive fire from air force planes and naval vessels, landed on the island and were joined by paratroopers from the army and Revolutionary Guards.
The forces defeated the mock enemy in the manoeuvres held in a 2,000 square km (770 square mile) area, the radio added.
Some 100 ships, including destroyers, gunboats, hovercraft and Iran's two Russian-built submarines were taking part in the exercise, backed by 40 planes and helicopters.

Britain and the United Arab Emirates on Thursday signed a defence cooperation accord which pledged British help to deter aggression if the oil-rich Gulf state, nervous about an Iranian arms buildup, is threatened.
Tehran, which is engaged in a dispute with the UAE over sovereignty of three strategic Gulf islands, says its military programme is purely defensive.
Western naval sources on Tuesday confirmed an Iranian report that Iran, the only Gulf state with submarines, would soon receive a third Russian diesel submarine.
